limitations: Saved solver UNSAT verdicts and compiled solver semantics are trusted; these runs did not archive kernel-checkable DRAT proofs. The eight PDR runs also saved invariants and explicit successful invariant self-check logs.
SEQ certificate strength2 includes composed original-machine invariants plus combinational UNSAT; it is not synonymous with a new F1 call per candidate.

SAT witnesses deliberately assign PI and RO freely and need not be reachable; they prove non-combinationality, not correctness. Correctness comes from unconditional invariants/complete SEQ certificates and independent loaded-to-final DSEC.
Primary AND is same-selected-set removal of free-state-SAT Build candidates, not total graph reduction or a sum of per-root heuristic gain.
Only saved loaded all-output signal semantics are claimed; raw-language or external protocol assumptions are not introduced.
scope: Independent read-only mem_ctrl evidence reconstruction plus separately rerun independent checker DSEC. No optimization or original-product edits.
